verdict.rationale: Expensify's 'Ask Expensify AI anything' feature gives in-product AI answers and charts about account data, from monthly spend to quarterly flux analysis (expensify-docs-22). It can also help users fix setup mistakes conversationally (expensify-docs-4). The core of AI-generated insights from your own data is documented, but only in a vendor blog post. Missing for 10: evidence of proactive AI suggestions rather than answers on request, in-depth product documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
